description: Puts a person of the account in a team, whatever their rank. It opens no queue: they see the threads handed to the team only on the queues they already work, which add_queue_operator decides. A deactivated account is refused.

person.description: The email address the person signs in with, which is not the same thing as the mailbox: it is how the account knows them.

team.description: The slug of the team, as list_teams gives it.

name: add_team_member
title: Put someone in a team
